mandatory_constraint: AI-Infra-Guard SHALL NOT become an FA3 identity, authorization, MCP/capability-gateway, model-routing, host-resource, evidence/provenance, secrets, network-egress, artifact-trust, promotion or canonical-registry authority.

rules.name: AISEC_DETERMINISTIC_FIRST_SECURITY_VALIDATION
rules.requirement: Known policy/invariant checks MUST be grounded in deterministic reproducible evidence before optional LLM augmentation.
rules.enforcement: Executable positive/negative regression plus canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AISEC_LLM_OUTPUT_NOT_SECURITY_AUTHORITY
rules.requirement: LLM analysis MUST NOT be the sole security verdict basis and MUST NOT act as security or promotion authority.
rules.enforcement: Executable positive/negative regression plus canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AISEC_SCAN_COVERAGE_EXPLICIT
rules.requirement: Every scan MUST declare examined, excluded and unsupported artifacts, scan depth and analysis modes.
rules.enforcement: Executable positive/negative regression plus canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AISEC_RUNTIME_REACHABLE_ARTIFACT_COMPLETENESS
rules.requirement: A PASS verdict MUST cover every runtime-reachable executable artifact; omitted or unsupported reachable artifacts fail closed.
rules.enforcement: Executable positive/negative regression plus canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AISEC_SECURITY_ENGINES_INDEPENDENTLY_VERSIONED
rules.requirement: Security engines MUST expose independently attributable/versioned identities for the analysis modes they execute.
rules.enforcement: Executable positive/negative regression plus canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AISEC_RULESET_VERSION_AND_DIGEST_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Every ruleset used for a security verdict MUST carry version plus immutable digest.
rules.enforcement: Executable positive/negative regression plus canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AISEC_TYPED_SCHEMA_VALIDATED_SECURITY_RULES
rules.requirement: Security rules and findings MUST be typed and schema-validated before use as canonical evidence.
rules.enforcement: Executable positive/negative regression plus canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AISEC_STATIC_DYNAMIC_ADVERSARIAL_EVIDENCE_SEPARATED
rules.requirement: Static, dynamic and adversarial evidence MUST remain distinguishable and attributable.
rules.enforcement: Executable positive/negative regression plus canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AISEC_SECURITY_TEST_CAPABILITY_SCOPED
rules.requirement: Red-team/scanner tool execution MUST be capability-scoped and separately authorized; arbitrary shell/network authority is forbidden.
rules.enforcement: Executable positive/negative regression plus canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AISEC_SCAN_TARGET_AND_EXTERNAL_RESPONSES_UNTRUSTED
rules.requirement: Scan targets, remote responses and LLM outputs MUST be treated as untrusted input.
rules.enforcement: Executable positive/negative regression plus canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AISEC_SARIF_PROJECTION_NON_CANONICAL
rules.requirement: SARIF MAY be emitted as an external projection, but MUST NOT replace the provider-neutral FA3 SecurityEvidence schema.
rules.enforcement: Executable positive/negative regression plus canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AISEC_SECURITY_VERDICT_EVIDENCE_BOUND
rules.requirement: Security PASS MUST bind scanner identity, ruleset identity, target digest, coverage, evidence IDs and verdict.
rules.enforcement: Executable positive/negative regression plus canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AISEC_MUTATION_BYPASS_REGRESSION_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Scanners MUST maintain replayable positive/negative bypass and mutation regression cases.
rules.enforcement: Executable positive/negative regression plus canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AISEC_MODEL_PROVIDER_IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Requested model/provider identity MUST be checked against observed/attested identity when API/model integrity is in scope.
rules.enforcement: Executable positive/negative regression plus canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AISEC_UNRESOLVED_CRITICAL_FINDING_BLOCKS_PROMOTION
rules.requirement: Any unresolved critical finding MUST block affected-scope promotion; scanner UI state cannot override this.
rules.enforcement: Executable positive/negative regression plus canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AISEC_SCANNER_CONFORMANCE_AND_NON_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: The scanner itself MUST pass conformance/bypass regression and remain non-root/non-authoritative with capability count 143.
rules.enforcement: Executable positive/negative regression plus canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.
